packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry Go moves as one unit, core and contrib together. Renovate's monorepo registry maps these to TWO groups by source URL — `opentelemetry-go` and `opentelemetry-go-contrib` — which is exactly the split this rule exists to prevent: core is on v1.44.x while contrib is on v0.6x, and upgrading one side alone is what breaks. This rule sits after the inherited presets and sets `groupName` without `groupSlug`, so Renovate re-derives the slug from it and this grouping wins.
Connect-RPC Go modules. No upstream group covers connectrpc.com.
Go `tool` directive entries — build tooling, not runtime dependencies, so they move together and carry the same risk profile as devDependencies elsewhere.

The liverty-music schema SDK is advanced by the OpenSpec change that alters the schema, together with the code migration that change requires — never on its own schedule. `enabled: false` rather than `ignoreDeps` deliberately: this keeps the dependency listed on the dependency dashboard as disabled-with-an-update-available, so a schema release whose consumers were never advanced stays visible. See design D7.
